days_list.title: Arrive in Casablanca
days_list.description: Meet your team on arrival and transfer to your hotel. Depending on arrival time, enjoy a gentle introduction to the city or time to settle in.
days_list.image_alt: Palace courtyard with fountain and arches

days_list.title: Casablanca → Rabat → Fès
days_list.description: Discover selected highlights of Casablanca before continuing to Rabat for Hassan Tower, the Mohammed V Mausoleum and the Kasbah of the Udayas, time permitting. Continue to Fès.
days_list.image_alt: Marrakech palace interior

days_list.title: Fès — The Living Medina
days_list.description: Explore Fès el-Bali with your Guardian Guide, discovering historic madrasas, artisan quarters, Nejjarine Square, traditional craftsmanship and the city's layered cultural heritage.
days_list.image_alt: Craft stalls in the Fès medina

days_list.title: Fès — Heritage & Craft
days_list.description: A second day allows a deeper exploration of Fès, including the Mellah and Jewish heritage sites, pottery and zellij traditions, or other interests selected with your advisor.
days_list.image_alt: Craft stalls in the Fès medina

days_list.title: Fès → Marrakech
days_list.description: Travel to Marrakech by private vehicle. This is a substantial overland transfer; confirm timing around guest preferences and road conditions. Arrive and settle into your riad or hotel.
days_list.image_alt: Kasbah in the Atlas foothills

days_list.title: Marrakech — Imperial Marrakech
days_list.description: Discover the city's historic and cultural landmarks, which may include Bahia Palace, the Saadian Tombs, Koutoubia surroundings and Jemaa el-Fna, paced to the guests' interests.
days_list.image_alt: Marrakech palace interior

days_list.title: Marrakech — Your Way
days_list.description: Enjoy a flexible day for gardens, art, culinary discovery, wellness, artisan encounters, photography or a private shopping experience if requested.
days_list.image_alt: Riad lounge with carved plaster and lantern light

days_list.title: Departure
days_list.description: Private transfer to the airport for your onward journey.
days_list.image_alt: A guest looking out over Marrakech at dusk from a private terrace

highlights: Two full days in the Fès medina

days_list.title: Arrive in Casablanca or Rabat
days_list.description: Meet your team and transfer to Rabat for an easy first evening. Overnight in Rabat.
days_list.image_alt: Palace courtyard with fountain and arches

days_list.title: Rabat → Fès
days_list.description: Discover Rabat's historic landmarks, such as Hassan Tower, the Mohammed V Mausoleum and the Kasbah of the Udayas, before continuing to Fès.
days_list.image_alt: Marrakech palace interior

days_list.title: Fès — Medina & Monuments
days_list.description: A guided introduction to Fès el-Bali, its historic architecture, medina lanes, artisan quarters and cultural traditions.
days_list.image_alt: Craft stalls in the Fès medina

days_list.title: Fès — A Deeper Discovery
days_list.description: Explore further according to guest interests, with options such as Jewish heritage, traditional crafts, pottery, zellij or time to enjoy the riad.
days_list.image_alt: Craft stalls in the Fès medina

days_list.title: Fès → Casablanca → Marrakech
days_list.description: Travel to Casablanca for a visit to the Hassan II Mosque and lunch, then continue directly to Marrakech. Casablanca is a visit, not an overnight stop.
days_list.image_alt: Riad lounge with carved plaster and lantern light

days_list.title: Marrakech — The Red City
days_list.description: Discover Marrakech's key historic and cultural highlights with a flexible pace and time to absorb the atmosphere.
days_list.image_alt: Marrakech palace interior

days_list.title: Marrakech — Culture & Personal Interests
days_list.description: Choose from gardens, design, museums, culinary experiences, wellness or artisan encounters, according to the guests' preferences.
days_list.image_alt: A guest looking out over Marrakech at dusk from a private terrace

days_list.title: Marrakech — Flexible Day
days_list.description: A deliberately open day for independent time, a private experience or a slower rhythm in the city.
days_list.image_alt: Palace courtyard with fountain and arches

days_list.title: Marrakech → Agafay
days_list.description: Travel to Agafay for a glamping experience, with time for the landscape, sunset and dinner. The journey structure keeps the overnight accommodation count at 10 nights; final sequencing is confirmed in the proposal.
days_list.image_alt: Stony hills of the Agafay desert with white camp tents and the snow-capped Atlas behind

days_list.title: Agafay → High Atlas
days_list.description: Continue to a mountain retreat for a slower stay amid Atlas landscapes, with optional walks, village encounters or time to relax.
days_list.image_alt: Kasbah in the Atlas foothills

days_list.title: High Atlas → Airport
days_list.description: Depart directly from the Atlas accommodation to the appropriate airport. Transfer timing depends on the selected property and flight schedule.
days_list.image_alt: The earthen kasbah of Aït Benhaddou

days_list.description: Meet your team and transfer to your hotel. Rest after your journey, with city touring according to arrival time and preference.

days_list.title: Casablanca → Rabat → Fès
days_list.description: Continue through Rabat for selected imperial landmarks before the private transfer to Fès.
days_list.image_alt: Marrakech palace interior

days_list.title: Fès — The Historic Medina
days_list.description: Discover the medina with your Guardian Guide, including its architectural heritage, historic institutions and celebrated craft traditions.
days_list.image_alt: Craft stalls in the Fès medina

days_list.title: Volubilis & Winery Experience
days_list.description: Visit the Roman archaeological site of Volubilis with specialist interpretation where appropriate, followed by a private winery visit, lunch and wine tasting before returning to Fès.
days_list.image_alt: Palm oasis and kasbah walls

days_list.title: Fès → Erfoud
days_list.description: Travel south through changing landscapes toward Erfoud. This is a long driving day; departure and arrival timing should allow for comfort and road conditions.
days_list.image_alt: The earthen kasbah of Aït Benhaddou

days_list.title: Erfoud → Rissani → Fossils → Sahara
days_list.description: Explore Rissani and the region's fossil heritage, including “From Ancient Sea to Sahara — A Private Journey Through 400 Million Years of Moroccan History.” Continue to the desert camp by luxury 4x4.
days_list.image_alt: Sahara dunes

days_list.title: Sahara → Skoura
days_list.description: Leave the desert and travel toward Skoura, crossing the southern landscapes and the Road of a Thousand Kasbahs. The day involves substantial driving.
days_list.image_alt: Kasbah in the Atlas foothills

days_list.title: Skoura — Oasis Retreat
days_list.description: Enjoy a full day at leisure or select gentle experiences around the oasis, kasbah architecture and local life. The stay is designed for rest rather than constant touring.
days_list.image_alt: Palm oasis and kasbah walls

days_list.title: Skoura → Marrakech
days_list.description: Travel across the High Atlas toward Marrakech, with the route and stops adapted to conditions and guest preferences.
days_list.image_alt: The earthen kasbah of Aït Benhaddou

days_list.title: Marrakech — The Red City
days_list.description: Explore selected landmarks, gardens, medina quarters and cultural highlights with a flexible pace.
days_list.image_alt: Marrakech palace interior

days_list.title: Marrakech — Your Way
days_list.description: Keep the day open for culinary discovery, wellness, art, private shopping, photography or simply enjoying the hotel.
days_list.image_alt: Riad lounge with carved plaster and lantern light

days_list.description: Private transfer to the airport for your onward journey.
